topic: How the Anthropic Messages API, the OpenAI Responses API and the Google Gemini native API authenticate, stream text and tool calls, report usage and refuse over-window requests, and which vendors' OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints accept Moonzila's current request shape
notes: RUN 2 of 2 (DeepSeek, Mistral, OpenRouter, Ollama cloud models): 14 owner URLs typed P, no searches, 14 credits at depth deep. Run 1 is research/plan.json (18 credits). Mistral (U-14) and OpenRouter (U-15, U-19) now have named owner pages typed P instead of searches: a search hit is born S (research-kit lib/collect.mjs DEFAULT_SOURCE_TYPE) and a search can return the wrong page; the two searches moved to plan-conditional.json as the fallback if a named page 404s.
